findings.text: All 22 transactions listed in QRIS history 2 sum to Rp 4.400.000, contradicting the printed summary figure of "Rp9.400.000". This indicates the document total may have been altered or misstated.
findings.followUpQuestion: Mohon maaf Ibu Wati, pada riwayat QRIS bulan September tertulis total Rp9.400.000, namun rincian transaksi berjumlah Rp 4.400.000. Apakah kami bisa memeriksa mutasi rekening langsung dari aplikasi Dompet Usaha?
findings.followUpQuestionEn: Excuse me Ibu Wati, on the September QRIS history the printed total states Rp9.400.000, but the itemized rows sum to Rp 4.400.000. May we check the direct account statement in the Dompet Usaha application together?

findings.text: No shop photographs or owner interview audio recordings were gathered during the credit visit.
findings.followUpQuestion: Apakah petugas boleh mengambil dokumentasi foto kios serta tempat usaha Ibu Wati?
findings.followUpQuestionEn: May the loan officer take photo documentation of Ibu Wati's shop and business premises?

confirmations.text: Supplier purchase entries in the notebook match the dates and amounts on supplier receipts, such as the purchase on Notebook page 1 matching Receipt 1 at Rp 2.700.000.
The transactions recorded in QRIS history 1 match the summary total for August 2026 at Rp 6.300.000.

memo.headline: The application is marked inconsistent due to an unresolved discrepancy between individual QRIS transaction rows and the displayed monthly summary figure.

character.text: Toko Baju Bu Wati has operated as a clothing reseller in Surabaya for 6 years. While handwritten daily entries are maintained across notebook pages, an open question remains regarding QRIS history 2 where the listed transaction rows totaling Rp 4.400.000 do not reconcile with the printed summary header. Furthermore, audio interview evidence is not available in the case file to evaluate narrative consistency.

capacity.text: Proven monthly hard cash inflows via QRIS stand at Rp 5.350.000, while total claimed monthly turnover from the notebook reaches Rp 16.637.500. Accounting for monthly costs of Rp 11.850.000, the business reports an upper-end net surplus of Rp 4.787.500, although proven hard inflows alone fall below current operating purchases. Consequently, the lender's policy does not calculate a recommended maximum instalment, leaving the requested monthly instalment of Rp 1.455.793 to be verified through direct banking records.

capital.text: Business asset verification is limited because shop photographs were not gathered in the submission. The business shows regular reinvestment into inventory, evidenced by wholesale clothing receipts averaging Rp 11.100.000 monthly. Purchases include repeated acquisitions of items like kaos, gamis, and daster across multiple supplier invoices.

collateral.text: For KUR micro loans up to Rp 100.000.000, secondary physical collateral may not be mandated under applicable guidelines. No physical asset documentation or shop photos were provided in the file. The loan decision depends primarily on clarifying operational cash flows.

conditions.text: The borrower seeks working capital financing of Rp 25.000.000 over a term of 18 months. Toko Baju Bu Wati serves the retail apparel market in Surabaya, relying on a mix of digital QRIS payments and traditional cash transactions. Local trading conditions show recurring reorders from local konveksi and wholesale vendors across August and September 2026.

officerNextSteps: Conduct an on-site visit to inspect current merchandise stock and capture geocoded shop photographs.
Request direct bank settlement statements or original digital app access to clarify the September QRIS transaction totals.
Conduct a structured interview with the business owner regarding cash sales and record an interview summary.

ownerSummary.verified: Catatan buku harian Anda tersusun rapi serta bukti nota pembelian barang dagangan (kulakan) tercatat lengkap dan konsisten selama dua bulan terakhir.
ownerSummary.missing: Dokumentasi foto kios/toko dan rekaman penjelasan usaha belum tersedia, serta ringkasan riwayat transaksi QRIS bulan September perlu kami cocokkan kembali langsung dari mutasi rekening bank.
tips: Simpan dan cetak rekening koran atau mutasi bank yang terhubung dengan QRIS setiap akhir bulan.
Ambil beberapa foto kondisi stok baju, etalase, dan plang nama toko saat buka.
Catat penjualan tunai dan QRIS secara terpisah agar pembukuan kas semakin jelas.
ownerSummary.verifiedEn: Your daily ledger is neatly maintained, and supplier receipts for clothing stock purchases are complete and consistent over the past two months.
ownerSummary.missingEn: Shop photographs and interview records are not yet attached, and the September QRIS transaction summary needs to be reconciled directly with your bank account statements.
tipsEn: Keep and download monthly bank statements directly linked to your QRIS merchant wallet.
Take clear photos of your merchandise inventory, display shelves, and shop storefront.
Separate cash transactions from digital QRIS sales in your daily sales records.
